channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Doug Collins | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Doug Collins from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kwame Brown on Michael Jordan, Doug Collins
item.description:
Kwame Brown:

“You had a coach in Doug Collins who didn’t believe in playing young players, and Michael didn’t either,”

Kwame Brown on Michael Jordan, Doug Collins, Jan 17, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Thaddeus Young on Doug Collins
item.description:
“But if coach sees fit to bring me off the bench, then, hey, I’ll deal with that and just continue to play. I’ve done it before in my career when I had Doug Collins, who’s actually in Chicago as a special advisor. I played three straight years with him coming off the bench.“It’s no big deal. You’ve just got to come in and get your Lou Will on. But at the end of the day, like I said, I’m just here to help lead this team, help build culture and make sure we put ourselves in a position to win games.”

Thaddeus Young on Doug Collins, Jul 9, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Elton Brand on Doug Collins
item.description:
The Draft night move signaled to the locker room Collins had assumed an extreme influence over the front office.

“Rod Thorn was letting Collins do his thing and coach thought we reached our maximum potential and wanted to go another way,”

Elton Brand on Doug Collins, Jan 16, 2015. Source: LibertyBallers.com.

item.title: Danny Ferry on Doug Collins
item.description:
Danny Ferry:

“It would have been a great privilege working with Doug Collins. I think he’s a great basketball mind. . . . I got really comfortable with this opportunity as it relates to Bruce. What I get is a great sense of humility but also a sense of intense focus and passion and pride about what can happen here going forward, the resources, the willingness that made me excited about this opportunity.”

Danny Ferry on Doug Collins, Jun 25, 2012. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Doug Collins
item.description:
Andre Iguodala on his meeting with coach Doug Collins just before the lockout began:

“We spoke, it was really brief. It was about 10 minutes, it wasn’t long:”

Andre Iguodala on Doug Collins, Aug 31, 2011. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Doug Collins
item.description:
“If I wasn’t playing baseball, I would’ve certainly been one of the top five or six picks. I don’t think anyone in the NBA was thinking about that with me or Doug Collins. We were bigger. We were athletic.”

Danny Ainge on Doug Collins, Jan 28, 2011. Source: Yahoo! Sports.
